overview: The Arcane Quarter maintains the magical infrastructure of Katta Castellum, ensuring resonance stability and arcane harmony across the Loyalist city-state.
history: Constructed alongside the Academy to support arcane research and infrastructure.
Resonance conduits were installed to regulate magical flow across the city.
Stabilizer pylons were added after early arcane surges threatened civic districts.
The Quarter became the central hub for arcane technicians and resonance engineers.
hooks: A stabilizer pylon overload threatens the entire district.
A resonance conduit begins emitting anomalous arcane signatures.
A technician disappears during a deep‑field resonance scan.
A Senate envoy arrives to inspect arcane safety protocols.
